policy.objective: maximize safe recovery probability without weakening production qualification thresholds
policy.inclusion: reviewed-inactive cities with resolved Agoda mappings; all 64 provider-covered-but-inactive cities, all 6 mapped live-flights-only cities, then the strongest 80 live-stays-only cities
policy.exclusion: already active cities and all 130 unresolved Agoda mappings; mapping repair is reserved for a separate controlled wave
policy.activationPolicy: results remain inactive until reviewed and merged into a later activation snapshot; the 421-city allowlist is unchanged by this package
